inventory.sourceFigureDescription: VECTOR TABLE TYPESSETTING, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; ONE VLM pass at 120 DPI, glm-4.6v, saved to staging-ph18/vlm-census.txt): the α-blockers table, columns DRUG / APPLICATIONS / ADVERSE EFFECTS, printed as THREE shaded full-width band rows. Nonselective: 'Phenoxybenzamine' | 'Irreversible. Pheochromocytoma (used preoperatively) to prevent catecholamine (hypertensive) crisis.' and 'Phentolamine' | 'Reversible. Given to patients on MAO inhibitors who eat tyramine-containing foods and for severe cocaine-induced hypertension (2nd line). Also used to treat norepinephrine extravasation.' — the band's ADVERSE EFFECTS cell prints ONCE, vertically spanning both drug rows: 'Orthostatic hypotension, reflex tachycardia.' (VLM-confirmed; not repeated on the phentolamine row). α1 selective (-osin ending): 'Prazosin, terazosin, doxazosin, tamsulosin' | 'Urinary symptoms of BPH; PTSD (prazosin); hypertension (except tamsulosin).' | '1st-dose orthostatic hypotension, dizziness, headache.' — the source prints the p of '(prazosin)' in RED (its own embedded typographic mnemonic, VLM-confirmed). α2 selective: 'Mirtazapine' | 'Depression.' | 'Sedation, ↑ serum cholesterol, ↑ appetite.' (the text layer prints both mirtazapine cells BEFORE the band label — the m38 interleave).
